accomplishments.title: The Uber hack
accomplishments.body: Uber kept surging near my college, so I started saving drivers' numbers after every ride. Eventually I had a WhatsApp group of 40-something drivers, plus my friends. Need a ride? Text the group. No surge, no app fee, and drivers liked it because they got a guaranteed ride when free.

accomplishments.title: Beating Wall Street at its own game
accomplishments.body: Built a housing market model that became the most accurate prediction in the US for 2023 — beating economists, banks, and financial publications by a wide margin, off by just a few basis points. Covered by ResiClub and Fortune.
